summary:
Digital Product Leadership in BFSI: Digital Product Manager with over 7 years of experience in
Banking and Financial Services, specializing in digital lending platforms, product strategy, and
execution across Microfinance, Personal Loans, and Home Loans.
End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership: Extensive experience managing the complete product
lifecycle—requirement gathering, BRD/FSD preparation, solution design, roadmap ownership, UAT
governance, and production roll-out—ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery.
Lending Platforms & Domain Expertise: Strong functional expertise in Loan Origination Systems
(LOS), Loan Management Systems (LMS), BRE, collections, payments, and UPI integrations, with
hands-on involvement in both greenfield implementations and system enhancements.
Large-Scale Digital Transformation Initiatives: Led the end-to-end implementation of the MFI
customer journey, improving process efficiency by 30%, reducing loan processing time by 20%,
increasing loan disbursement volumes by 15%, and improving customer satisfaction by 25%.
Payments & Collections Modernization: Transformed manual collection processes by introducing
BBPS and QR-based payment systems, considerably reducing ground-level manual effort, lowering
hiring costs for collection staff, and improving customer payment convenience.
API Integrations & Automation Enablement: Drove API-led integrations with EPFO, payment
gateways, employer verification systems, bank statement analysis tools, and banking partners,
resulting in reduced manual intervention and faster credit and disbursement decisioning.
Straight-Through Processing & Cost Optimization: Enabled one-click disbursements and e-signing
workflow, eliminating physical document storage requirements, reducing turnaround time, and
enabling direct, real-time disbursements to customer bank accounts.
Stakeholder & Team Leadership: Successfully led and mentored teams of up to 5 members (UAT
analysts and junior BAs), while acting as a critical liaison between business, technology, compliance,
and vendor stakeholders to ensure alignment and delivery excellence.
Data-Driven & Compliance-Focused Product Delivery: Showcased strong command over regulatory
compliance, risk management, and data-driven decision-making, leveraging analytics and user
feedback to enhance product adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency.
